detail.longDescription: Just tested FrogFind on a real PowerMac 6100 (Mac OS 8.1, Netscape 3.01) and stumbled across two hilarious 1996-era bugs! 🍏💻 1️⃣ Invisible Images: It turns out Netscape 3 has NO idea what a PNG is! Our proxy now transcodes all modern images (WebP/PNG) into pure Baseline JPEGs on the fly and injects hardcoded width/height tags so the ancient layout engine doesn't panic. 🖼️➡️📼 2️⃣ Identity Crisis: The old Netscape 'PPC' User-Agent was falsely flagged by our stats as a 'Pocket PC' (Windows CE) instead of a PowerPC Mac. The ultimate insult to a classic Mac! 🤦‍♂️ Both are now patched! FrogFind is more 1996-accurate than ever. Keep the retro web alive! 🐸🌍 # RetroComputing # VintageApple # Netscape # PowerPC # MacOS8 # WebDev # FrogFind
